# Introduction

In this notebook, we use mean-variance and mean-conditional value at risk optimization techniques to analyse the risk-return trade-offs

# Data cleaning

```{r}
rm(list=ls())         # clear 

library(sp)
library(dplyr)
library(rio)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)

## Loading required package: agro
#if (!require(agro))  source("https://install-github.me/reagro/agro")

#ff <- agro::get_data_from_uri("hdl:11529/11082", ".")
#ff
#remotes::install_github('carob-data/yuri')
library("yuri")

ff=yuri::dataURI ("hdl:11529/11082", ".")
ff
CSISA_platform_trial <- read.csv("./hdl_11529_11082/RawData_RP1.csv", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

#CSISA_platform_trial

CSISA_platform_trial$SCENARIO_DET=paste0(CSISA_platform_trial$SCENARIO,CSISA_platform_trial$CEST,CSISA_platform_trial$TILL)
```

# Kharif Example

## Risk metrics

```{r}
# Descriptive statistics 
#install.packages("remotes")
#remotes::install_github("TimothyKBook/rutilstb")
library(modelsummary)

library(rutilstb)

CSISA_platform_trial_k=subset(CSISA_platform_trial,CSISA_platform_trial$SEASON=="Kharif")

rice_yield=tabstat(CSISA_platform_trial_k, var=c("YIELD"),by="SCENARIO")
rice_yield
```

## Yield optimization

```{r}
library(psych)

CSISA_platform_trial_kharif=describeBy(CSISA_platform_trial_k[,c("YIELD","YEAR","SCENARIO")], group=c("YEAR","SCENARIO"), mat=TRUE)

CSISA_platform_trial_kharif=subset(CSISA_platform_trial_kharif,!(is.na(CSISA_platform_trial_kharif$n)))

CSISA_platform_trial_kharif=subset(CSISA_platform_trial_kharif,CSISA_platform_trial_kharif$vars==1)



CSISA_platform_trial_kharif=CSISA_platform_trial_kharif[,c("group1","group2","mean")]

# Convert to wide
CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide=xtabs(mean ~ group1 + group2, data = CSISA_platform_trial_kharif)

class(CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide)=NULL
CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide=as.data.frame(CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide)

library(lubridate)
date=dmy(c("01-01-2010","01-01-2011","01-01-2012","01-01-2013","01-01-2014","01-01-2015","01-01-2016"))
CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide$date=date

library(fPortfolio)

library(timeSeries)
rownames(CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide) <- CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide$date
CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide$date=NULL
CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide_ts <- timeSeries(CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide)


# Download the data
#CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide_ts

library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
library(fontawesome)

htmltools::browsable(
  tagList(
    tags$button(
      tagList(fontawesome::fa("download"), "Download as CSV"),
      onclick = "Reactable.downloadDataCSV('CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide_ts', 'CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide_ts.csv')"
    ),
    
    reactable(
      CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide_ts,
      searchable = TRUE,
      defaultPageSize = 38,
      elementId = "CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide_ts"
    )
  )
)

# Risk frontier 

covOGKEstimate <- covOGKEstimator(CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide_ts)
fastCovOGKEstimator <- function(x, spec = NULL, ...) covOGKEstimate

covOGKSpec <- portfolioSpec()
setEstimator(covOGKSpec) <- "fastCovOGKEstimator"
setNFrontierPoints(covOGKSpec) <- 5

covOGKFrontier <- portfolioFrontier(
data = CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide_ts, spec = covOGKSpec)
print(covOGKFrontier)

setNFrontierPoints(covOGKSpec) <- 20
covOGKFrontier <- portfolioFrontier(
data = CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide_ts, spec = covOGKSpec)
tailoredFrontierPlot(
covOGKFrontier,
mText = "OGK Robustified MV Portfolio",
risk = "Sigma")

col = divPalette(4, "RdYlGn")
weightsPlot(covOGKFrontier, col = col, mtext = FALSE)
text <- "OGK Robustified MV Portfolio"
mtext(text, side = 3, line = 3, font = 2, cex = 0.9)

```

# Stochastic Dominance

### Theoretical graphs and kolmogorov smirnov test

```{r}
# Theoretical graphs ------------------------------------------------------------

# Truncated normal -----------------------
library(truncnorm)
g <- rtruncnorm (n=1000,a=4,b=8, mean=6,sd=0.8 )
q <- rtruncnorm (n=1000,a=4,b=8, mean=5,sd=1 )
f <- rtruncnorm (n=1000,a=3,b=9, mean=5,sd=2 )
df <- data.frame(x = c(g, q, f),Scenarios = factor(rep(c("G","Q","F"), c(1000,1000,1000))))
df <- df[order(df$x), ]

df$ecdf <- ave(df$x, df$Scenarios, FUN=function(x) seq_along(x)/length(x))

library(ggplot2)
stochasticdominance=ggplot(df, aes(x, ecdf, colour =   Scenarios,linetype=Scenarios)) + 
  geom_line(lwd=c(1.5))+
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(1,2,3))+
  # theme(axis.ticks = element_blank(),axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  xlab("Yield (tons/ha)") +
  ylab("Cumulative probability") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkred","darkgreen","orange"))+
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())+
  theme(panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())+
  theme_bw(base_size=20)
stochasticdominance


# Kolmogorov smirnov test
ks.test(g,f, alternative = "less")
ks.test(g,q, alternative = "less")
ks.test(q,f,alternative = "less")

```

# Certainty Equivalence

```{r}

library(ceRtainty)

# Computing the CE values, for a RAC range of 0.5-4.0, and Power utility function.
#
# Obtaining the CE table
certainty(data = CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide, ival = 0.5, fval = 4, utility = "Power")$CE_values

# Obtaining the RAC vector
certainty(data=CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide,ival=.5,fval=4,utility="Power")$RAC

# Performing the CE plot
certainty(data=CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide,ival=.5,fval=4,utility="Power")$CE_plot()


```

### Using Kharif data

```{r}

# Plot ECDF mapped by group
ggplot(CSISA_platform_trial_kharif, aes(x = mean, color = group2)) +
  stat_ecdf(geom = "step", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Empirical CDF",
       x = "Net returns across scenarios",
       y = "Cumulative Proportion") +
  theme_bw(base_size=20)

# Kolmogorov smirnov test


ks.test(CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide_ts$`1`, CSISA_platform_trial_kharif_wide_ts$`2`)



```
